answer: Work history locks for 30 epochs before it counts, every landed answer goes to a second panel one epoch later, and no identity can sit on the panel of an identity it recruited, which is why a farm cannot review its own output no matter how many seats it holds. That rule is the expensive one. A thousand-seat operation must source a thousand reviewers from outside its own graph at 50 POA a seat before the first basalt block is poured, and it still waits 30 epochs before the summit is reachable. The raven gets nothing for arriving early.
